name: What types of drafty window issues can you fix?

mainEntity.name: What types of drafty window issues can you fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can address a wide range of drafty window issues. This includes replacing deteriorated or missing weatherstripping, re-caulking gaps around window frames, repairing or replacing broken sashes, and adjusting hardware to ensure a tighter fit. We also handle minor wood rot on frames, repair loose glass panes, and address issues stemming from improper installation. Our goal is to seal your windows effectively, preventing air leaks and improving your home's insulation.
acceptedAnswer.description: We fix issues like deteriorated weatherstripping, cracked caulk, broken sashes, loose glass, and minor frame rot to prevent air leaks.
